note: FNS 1161.3 describes QC reviewer procedures for handling three types of caseworker errors discovered during audits: mathematical mistakes in expense calculations, policy misapplication, and failure to act on shelter changes after an address change. These are audit correction instructions (what the reviewer must document and correct), not caseworker policy. The underlying caseworker responsibilities ARE covered in the OLG: (1) Address changes must trigger shelter/utility expense review — covered in 'Simplified Reporting - Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance' (send VC-1 for shelter/utility costs) and 'Address (RFA)' (cold call procedure requiring VC-1 if shelter/utility not updated); (2) Expense processing rules including verification requirements — covered in 'Expenses/Deductions Introduction'; (3) Benefit calculations including conversions — handled by BEACON with worker guidance in 'How SNAP Benefits are Calculated'. The FNS section's specific focus on QC reviewer documentation and correction methodology has no caseworker equivalent in the OLG, which is appropriate since the OLG is a caseworker guide, not a QC manual. DTA's QC Compliance page exists but appropriately covers the QC process at a high level rather than replicating FNS audit procedures.
